evidence.detail: prepare_card() calls set_legal_icons(c) which sets c.legal_icons to a multi-link HTML string
cards2_api() calls prepare_cards(cs, ...) then return_camelized_json, which humps.camelize()s legal_icons → legalIcons and includes it in every card object in the JSON response
React cardtable consuming /api/cards2 renders only name, numDecks, record, winPercent, tournamentWins, tournamentTop8s, perfectRuns — legalIcons is never read
extra_serializer calls obj.to_dict() on Container/Munch objects, so all dynamically-set attributes including legal_icons are serialized

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/controllers/api.py inside cards2_api(), after the prepare_cards() call, add: `for c in cs: c.pop('legal_icons', None)`. Alternatively, add an `api_only=True` flag to prepare_card() and skip set_legal_icons when True. The pop approach is 2 lines and has zero risk to server-side rendering paths.
triage.notes: legal_icons contains full HTML with anchor tags and icon links; removing it from the API response reduces payload size per card. No frontend code needs updating.
